The '''Imperial Army Officer Corps''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kullan Velerinden]] was considered to be one of the best examples of the Corps due to his combat expertise and willingness to lead from the front. However, he was also one of the worst because he engaged in war profiteering, racketeering and blackmail.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
